_doc: Sesi Bootloader TM81 — masuk ke mode Bootloader, bersihkan metadata OTA di EEPROM, lalu baca uptime BL. Device harus dalam mode App saat memulai.
label: TM81 Session BL
_doc_tests: Urutan: App→BL (reboot ke bootloader) → BL→App (validasi/soft reset ke App) → BL Clear OTA (reset metadata EEPROM) → Uptime Get (baca lama di mode BL).

tests.name: app_goto_bl
tests.label: App Goto BL
tests.description: Reboot device dari App ke mode Bootloader (CMD 0x05, boot reason = IrDA OTA)

tests.name: bl_goto_app
tests.label: BL Goto App
tests.description: Validasi image lalu soft reset dari Bootloader kembali ke App (safety gate aktif — tolak jika image belum lengkap)

tests.name: bl_clear_ota
tests.label: BL Clear OTA
tests.description: Reset metadata OTA di EEPROM (fw_size=0, fw_crc=0, last_frame_id=0xFFFF) — CMD BL 107

tests.name: uptime_get
tests.label: Get BL Uptime
tests.description: Baca lama device di mode Bootloader + estimasi konsumsi (cmd 108)
